style.description: Original friendly product-isometric emoji: each subject is a compact object built from a few simple, slightly rounded geometric volumes, shown in a true isometric view like a small onboarding illustration. Flat matte faces with a fixed three-tone light model, calm muted palette and one warm accent. Not a reproduction of any company's illustration system, mascot, palette, typeface or icons.
style.perspective: true isometric view: top face and two side faces visible; vertical edges vertical; receding edges at 30 degrees; no vanishing point or foreshortening
style.projection: the object is turned 45 degrees about its vertical axis and seen from about 35 degrees above the horizon; parallel edges stay parallel; the whole set shares this exact angle
style.lighting: fixed upper-left key: top faces lightest, left faces mid tone, right faces darkest (three values per color); no cast shadow, ground plane or floor contact shadow
style.outline: none; faces are separated only by the three tone steps
style.detailLevel: low: 3 to 6 primary volumes per subject; no surface texture; the smallest meaningful detail is at least 1/12 of the object width
materials: optional subtle linear gradient inside one face, at most 8% lightness change
style.accentPolicy: one warm tangerine accent per asset, placed only on the meaning-bearing part; every other face uses the base palette

palette.rule: derive each color's top, left and right faces from one hue by lightness steps; do not introduce extra hues

style.contrastRule: the silhouette must separate from both white and near-black UI: keep the darkest face above about 30% lightness and the lightest top face below about 94% lightness; never black-on-black or white-on-white edges
style.edgeRounding: soft rounded corners of about 6% of the object width on every volume; no sharp spikes or hairline struts
style.projectionExceptions: faces, hands and gestures keep frontal readable features (eyes, mouth, fingers) on a volume that still follows the three-tone light model; the token subject must state the exception
style.smallSizeRule: at 24 px the top face and at least one side face must stay distinguishable; prefer chunky volumes over thin isometric edges
